fact: At the 11th Public Procurement Forum 2025 the Deputy Finance Minister said that from January 2026 the Controller and Accountant-General's Department would stop issuing manual cheques, enforcing full use of GHANEPS integrated with GIFMIS, and that all Ministry of Finance procurement and payment processes would use the integrated mechanism to end of 2025.
title: Finance Ministry Reaffirms Commitment to Transparent Procurement — GHANEPS to Become Mandatory from 2026
